court.serves_note: Thousand Oaks residents typically use East County Courthouse in Simi Valley for civil filings, though main courthouse in Ventura also serves the city
court.snippet: The Ventura County Superior Court serves the community by providing fair, impartial, and accessible justice. As the trial court for Ventura County, the Court handles a wide range of cases, including criminal, civil, family law, probate, juvenile, traffic, and small claims matters.
